subject: Co-hosted hybrid webinar + booth at CloudCon Q4 — partnership proposal
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.z@spectracloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@spectracloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Co-marketing idea: hybrid webinar + CloudCon booth (Q4)

Hi Grace & Logan,

Following up from our brief chat at EdgeSummit — SpectraCloud would love to co-host a hybrid webinar and share a 10x10 booth at CloudCon (Oct 18-20). High-level ask:

- Joint webinar on Oct 19 (noon ET) with a 30–40 minute demo + 15 min Q&A
- Shared booth presence across the three-day event (we can split staffing days)
- MDF request: $8,000 to cover booth carpeting, table graphics, and joint attendee promo (we can cover shipping and some labor)

Audience fit looks strong (edges/cloud infra). I attached our partner deck for context. Can you confirm Redwood's appetite and an initial MDF stance? If we can lock dates this week we can get the booth floorplan with ExpoWorks.

Thanks — excited about this one.

Emily Zhao
Head of Partnerships | SpectraCloud
emily.z@spectracloud.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: SpectraCloud_PartnerDeck.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.z@spectracloud.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-marketing idea: hybrid webinar + CloudCon booth (Q4)

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the deck. Looping in Logan (revenue ops) and Vivek (events ops) to assess MDF and staffing. Quick thoughts from my side:

- Webinar: Redwood can provide 1 product lead + 1 solutions engineer for the demo slot; we ask SpectraCloud to provide the customer-facing success story and one solution architect. Proposed run: 30m demo / 15m joint Q&A.
- Booth staffing: Redwood can commit to onsite coverage Oct 18 & 19 and partial support Oct 20 (2 people onsite + 1 floater). Can SpectraCloud cover Oct 19 & 20 additional coverage?
- MDF: we generally do 50/50 MDF up to $6k. For strategic co-sell opportunities we can be flexible. Can you share expected lead volume or an ARR target tied to this campaign?
- Timeline: need signed MOU by Sep 15 to make ExpoWorks deadlines.

I attached a short SOW template (I will send after internal review). If OK, Logan — can you confirm whether we can approve an exception on MDF up to $10k with a 60/40 split in Redwood's favor? Vivek — can you confirm booth builder lead times and any extra costs?

On Sep 04, 2026, Emily wrote:
> Following up from our brief chat at EdgeSummit — SpectraCloud would love to co-host a hybrid webinar and share a 10x10 booth at CloudCon (Oct 18-20). High-level ask:
> - Joint webinar on Oct 19 (noon ET) with a 30–40 minute demo + 15 min Q&A
> - Shared booth presence across the three-day event (we can split staffing days)
> - MDF request: $8,000 to cover booth carpeting, table graphics, and joint attendee promo

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: SpectraCloud CloudCon co-marketing — MDF & ops ask

Team — short internal thread before I reply back.

Proposal summary: SpectraCloud asks $8k MDF. They bring partner deck and reasonable demand gen. I recommend we approve a slightly larger MDF contribution for this one because:
- High overlap with our enterprise accounts (3 named customers in the deck)
- Strong co-sell signal from their outbound list (they promised 1,200 targeted invites)

Recommended MDF: Redwood contribution $6,000, SpectraCloud $4,000 (total $10,000). We take a 60/40 lead credit split (Redwood 60%).
Operational asks:
- Booth build: Vivek to confirm ExpoWorks quote and whether floorplan upgrades push cost over budget
- Travel: policy is to avoid covering partner travel; we should expect SpectraCloud to cover their travel unless there's a negotiated exception
- Legal: require standard partner MOU + data handling addendum for webinar registrants

Logan — can you confirm finance ok with $6k MDF (charge to Q4 demand budget)? If yes I'll reply to Emily with the numbers and next steps (MOU by Sep 15, dry run Oct 12).

Grace
From: Emily Zhao <emily.z@spectracloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@spectracloud.com>, ExpoWorks Events <events@expoworks.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-hosted hybrid webinar + booth at CloudCon Q4 — partnership proposal

Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround and sensible suggestions. We can accept the proposed staffing split and the Oct 19 webinar slot (noon ET). A couple of asks from our side:

- Can Redwood provide a 20-minute joint customer story slot in the webinar? We have one customer willing to speak (will need travel stipend).
- We prefer MDF to be split as you suggested; we can confirm $4k from our side.
- Attached: Draft MOU (v0.2) — please review and advise any redlines.

Next steps:
1) If you can confirm Redwood MDF $6k, we will sign the MOU and route to legal.
2) ExpoWorks, please confirm the floorplan and include a quote for upgraded lighting (SpectraCloud will consider paying for lighting if needed).

Looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Emily

Attachment: Draft_MOU_SpectraCloud_Redwood_v0.2.docx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.z@spectracloud.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-hosted hybrid webinar + booth at CloudCon Q4 — partnership proposal

Emily — confirmed. Redwood approves MDF contribution of $6,000; SpectraCloud commits $4,000 (total MDF pool $10,000). We agree to the 60/40 lead credit split as discussed. Key next steps:

- Sign MOU by Sep 15: I attached the finalized SOW and a signed stub of the MOU for your records. Please review the SOW (Webinar_SOW.docx) and the staffing roster we propose.
- Dry run: Oct 12 at 11:00 ET — mandatory for all presenters.
- Onsite staffing: Redwood provides two onsite reps Oct 18–19 and one floater Oct 20. SpectraCloud to provide two onsite reps Oct 19–20.
- Customer speaker: happy to provide a $500 travel stipend for the customer story; SpectraCloud to arrange travel.
- Legal/data: Irene will send the data handling addendum and a DocuSign packet. DocuSign link included.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/packet/ABCD-1234-REDWOOD-SPECTRA
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSpectraDrive

If everyone is aligned I'll route the final MOU for signature today.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
